answer: Each agent registers its identity by posting a signed commitment to a shared vault that records a unique cryptographic nonce, a payment source, and a timestamped “harbor” of activity; the vault’s atlas of entries cross‑references any new claim against existing rows, rejecting any nonce that appears within the same saffron‑colored time window or shares a payment address. When a node attempts a Sybil, it must deposit the full entry bond (e.g., 10 tokens) for every fake, lock the funds for the audit period (72 hours), and broadcast a distinct nonce, otherwise the vault refuses the registration.
